items.labelZh: 住戶每月入息中位數
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department, Quarterly Report on General Household Survey, Q1 2026
items.note: All domestic households. Economically active households were HK$40,600 in the same quarter. Released 28 May 2026. Figures for 2025 in that release were subject to routine revision.

items.labelZh: 從事經濟活動住戶每月入息中位數
items.labelEn: Median monthly income of economically active households
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department, Quarterly Report on General Household Survey, Q1 2026
items.note: A household with at least one member, excluding foreign domestic helpers, who is economically active.

items.labelZh: 就業人士每月就業收入中位數
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department, Quarterly Report on General Household Survey, Q1 2026
items.note: Employed persons. This release does not publish a matching median by age or occupation in the key tables used here.

items.labelZh: 按年齡劃分的每月就業收入中位數
items.labelEn: Median monthly employment earnings by age
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department
items.note: Not verified as a single current table. Left blank rather than estimated. Peer context uses the overall employment median.

items.labelZh: 按職業劃分的每月就業收入中位數
items.labelEn: Median monthly employment earnings by occupation
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department
items.note: Not verified for this snapshot. Occupation remains a free-text note and is not used as a peer band.

items.labelZh: 住戶開支調查平均數
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department
items.note: A current Household Expenditure Survey average was not verified for this snapshot. Spending comparisons use the visitor's own monthly spending.

items.labelZh: 綜合消費物價指數按年變動
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department, Consumer Price Indices for August 2026
items.note: Headline Composite CPI, August 2026 compared with August 2025. The underlying rate, excluding one-off government relief, was 1.9% in the same release. Released 23 September 2026.

items.labelZh: 基本綜合消費物價指數按年變動
items.sourceName: Census and Statistics Department, Consumer Price Indices for August 2026
items.note: Excludes the effects of the Government's one-off relief measures. Shown beside the headline rate; purchasing-power illustrations use the headline Composite CPI.

items.labelZh: 基本利率
items.sourceName: Hong Kong Monetary Authority
items.note: Set at 4.25% with immediate effect on 17 September 2026 under the HKMA pre-set formula. This is not a savings rate offered to depositors.

items.labelZh: 隔夜港元利息結算利率
items.sourceName: Hong Kong Association of Banks
items.note: Published as at 11:15 a.m. Hong Kong time on 21 October 2026. Commonly referred to as overnight HIBOR.

items.labelZh: 三個月港元利息結算利率
items.sourceName: Hong Kong Association of Banks
items.note: Published as at 11:15 a.m. Hong Kong time on 21 October 2026. Used as a market-rate comparison, not as a rate a saver will receive.

items.labelZh: 儲蓄存款平均利率
items.sourceName: Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Monthly Statistical Bulletin table 6.4.2
items.note: Period-average savings deposit rate quoted by major licensed banks on deposits of less than HK$100,000, for the month ending September 2026. The published figure is 0.001 percent per annum, not 0.1 percent.

items.labelZh: 通脹掛鈎債券最新發行資料
items.sourceName: Hong Kong Monetary Authority
items.note: No single standing coupon was verified for this snapshot. Retail bond terms change with each issue, so the value is left blank.

items.labelZh: 銀色債券最新發行資料
items.sourceName: Hong Kong Monetary Authority
items.note: No single standing coupon was verified for this snapshot. Left blank rather than using a past issue.

items.labelZh: 強積金強制性供款率
items.sourceName: Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority
items.note: Employee and employer each contribute 5% of relevant income, inside the minimum and maximum levels. Verified on the MPFA employees page on 21 October 2026. Not a product recommendation.

items.labelZh: 強積金最低有關入息
items.sourceName: Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority
items.note: Monthly-paid employees below HK$7,100 do not make the employee contribution. The employer contribution still applies.

items.labelZh: 強積金最高有關入息
items.sourceName: Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority
items.note: Monthly mandatory contribution is capped at HK$1,500 each for the employer and the employee.

items.labelZh: 股票基金平均開支比率
items.sourceName: MPFA MPF Fund Platform, analysis of fund expense ratio
items.note: Average across equity constituent funds shown on the platform view dated 30 September 2026. FER is historical and is not a forecast or a suggestion to pick a fund.

items.labelZh: 混合資產基金平均開支比率
items.sourceName: MPFA MPF Fund Platform, analysis of fund expense ratio
items.note: Average across mixed-asset constituent funds on the same platform view. Not a product ranking.

items.labelZh: 強積金保守基金平均開支比率
items.labelEn: Average FER of MPF conservative funds
items.sourceName: MPFA MPF Fund Platform, analysis of fund expense ratio
items.note: Average for money-market funds in the MPF conservative fund category on the same platform view.

items.labelZh: 自願醫保標準計劃每年保障限額
items.labelEn: VHIS Standard Plan annual benefit limit
items.sourceName: Health Bureau, VHIS Certified Plan Policy Template, Standard Plan Benefit Schedule
items.note: Annual benefit limit for benefit items (a) to (l) is HK$420,000 per policy year. Lifetime benefit limit for those items is nil in the same schedule. This is a standardised reference, not a suggestion to buy a plan. Verified against the template published on vhis.gov.hk on 21 October 2026.

items.labelZh: 公營醫院急症病床每日收費（合資格人士）
items.labelEn: Public acute inpatient daily fee for eligible persons
items.sourceName: Hospital Authority, public charges for eligible persons
items.note: Acute general beds, effective 1 January 2026. Convalescent, rehabilitation, infirmary and psychiatric beds were HK$200 per day in the same list. A public-ward stay is not a guide to private hospital bills.

items.labelZh: 私家醫院典型住院費用
items.sourceName: Hospital Authority / Department of Health
items.note: No official single typical private inpatient bill was verified. The medical check uses the VHIS Standard Plan annual limit and the public acute daily fee instead.

items.labelZh: 應急錢常見月數下限
items.labelEn: Emergency-fund rule of thumb, low end
items.sourceName: Investor and Financial Education Council, The Chin Family
items.note: IFEC describes an emergency fund of three to six months of living expenses. This app still uses 3 months, or 6 months when there is a dependant, as its own reference.

items.labelZh: 應急錢常見月數上限
items.labelEn: Emergency-fund rule of thumb, high end
items.sourceName: Investor and Financial Education Council, The Chin Family
items.note: Upper end of the same IFEC three-to-six-month description.

items.labelZh: 投資者風險教育
items.sourceName: Investor and Financial Education Council, The Chin Family
items.note: No numeric SFC risk-class threshold was adopted. The learn card points at IFEC guidance to know your risk and avoid putting money you need soon into higher-risk holdings. A specific SFC product classification was not used, so no product is named.
